title.en: You forgot how to have fun

text.en: {cast:sibling} pulls your sleeve. "You never play anymore. You just count coins." Even Bujji looks bored of you.

label.en: Spend ₹100 on a day of fun with Chinni

outcome.en: Kites, ice candy and a muddy cricket match. ₹100 well spent.

why.en: Wants are part of a good budget. Saving every rupee isn't a plan, it's a punishment.

outcome.en: You save ₹100 more and catch a fever from exhaustion.

why.en: A plan you can't live with won't last. Leave room for small joys.

text.en: You haven't laughed in months. {cast:mentor}: "Kanna, money is for living. You've stopped living." Chinni calls you "the calculator".

label.en: Take the family on a ₹3,000 day trip

outcome.en: ₹3,000, one waterfall and Ammamma's first ride on a boat. Everyone talks about it for a year.

why.en: Joy is a need too. A budget with no wants breaks sooner or later.

outcome.en: ₹3,000 more and a back that hurts every morning.

why.en: Health and family are wealth too. Spend a little on them.

text.en: Snacks, top-ups, movies. {cast:shopkeeper} turns her [[khata]] around. "₹640, kanna. That's a whole page with your name."

label.en: Pay it back and cut wants for two months

outcome.en: ₹640 repaid in two months. The page is crossed out. You feel lighter.

why.en: Too many wants means the needs end up on credit. Balance is the goal.

label.en: Ask for one more week of credit

outcome.en: One more week becomes ₹900. Anjamma aunty tells Amma.

why.en: Credit for wants grows quietly until someone else has to pay.

text.en: New clothes, eating out, trips, gadgets. Life is fantastic. Then the month ends ₹12,000 short, and the card bill arrives.

label.en: Pay the bill in full and cut wants to 10% for three months

outcome.en: Three quiet months. ₹12,000 cleared, ₹0 interest. The fun comes back slowly, and paid for.

why.en: When spending runs ahead of income, the gap becomes debt. Reset early.

label.en: Pay the minimum and keep going

hint.en: The party is over. The bill isn't.

outcome.en: At 42%, the ₹12,000 becomes about ₹14,900 over a year.

why.en: Lifestyle on credit costs you twice: once now, and again in interest.

text.en: Dinner is silent. Amma says, "You count rupees, not people." Chinni won't sit next to you.

label.en: Buy sweets for everyone and say sorry

outcome.en: ₹150 of jalebis and one honest sorry. Chinni sits next to you again.

why.en: Money spent on people you love is not wasted. Needs, wants and family all fit in a plan.

label.en: Ignore it. They'll get over it

outcome.en: They do, slowly, over two cold weeks.

why.en: Saving money while losing people isn't a good trade.

text.en: You skipped the festival, the wedding and Ammamma's birthday to save money. Nanna has stopped calling.

label.en: Go home for a week with gifts for everyone

outcome.en: ₹5,000 and a week of Amma's cooking. Nanna pretends he wasn't waiting at the bus stop.

why.en: A budget includes people. Social spending is fine when it's planned.

outcome.en: The money arrives. You don't. Amma says thank you, politely.

why.en: Money helps, but it doesn't replace being there.

text.en: You've given your savings to everyone: Chinni, cousins, Chintu. Your dream jar is empty, and nobody has paid back.

label.en: Say a kind no, and start saving again

outcome.en: Chinni sulks for a day. In three months your jar is back to ₹300.

why.en: You can only help others if you keep something for yourself. Pay yourself first.

label.en: Keep giving. They need it more

outcome.en: Your jar stays at ₹0. Your cricket bat dream moves another year away.

why.en: Generosity without a limit leaves nothing for your own goals.

text.en: Uncles, cousins and neighbours queue up. You've lent ₹40,000 with no paper. Your own emergency fund is gone.

label.en: Set a family-help budget of ₹2,000 a month, and stick to it

outcome.en: Some relatives grumble. Your fund rebuilds to ₹24,000 in a year, and you still help ₹2,000 a month.

why.en: Your emergency fund protects the family too. Help from a budget, not from the cushion.

label.en: Borrow so you can keep lending

hint.en: Borrowing to be generous is still borrowing.

outcome.en: ₹20,000 from a loan app at 48%, lent to a cousin who repays ₹5,000.

why.en: Never borrow at high interest to lend for free.
